name: Staked Kerne Synthetic Dollar
description: skUSD is the staked form of kUSD, a standard ERC-4626 vault on Base. Depositors stake kUSD to receive skUSD, whose share price accrues protocol yield over time. The underlying asset is kUSD, a synthetic dollar minted 1:1 from USDC. Proof of reserves and a free on-chain verification tool are at kerne.fi/verify-anything.
